clue.text: Amerind we see quietly following fawn

explanation.surface: Someone spots a Native American creeping softly after a young deer.

clue.text: Cheese, in part, eaten by puss

explanation.definitionFit: Camembert is a soft creamy French cheese from Normandy.

clue.text: A metal among the best?

explanation.definitionFit: Platinum is a precious metal often ranked above gold as the finest grade.

clue.text: Horrid ruling cops backed up

clue.text: Fly by waterside plant

clue.text: Boasting cheat and braggart

a con is a swindle or cheat

explanation.surface: A list of a show-off's vices: boasting and cheating.
explanation.walkthrough: Gascony's people were proverbially boastful, hence the word for a braggart.

clue.text: Metamorphosis of Circe, that designing person

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: An architect is a person who designs buildings.

clue.text: Sample what a steak can provide

clue.text: Duck's catch, going round in pond and river

clue.text: Loots and boots out

clue.text: Happy tap dancing with poise

taken as written

clue.text: Junior's to pay for bloomer

clue.text: Red meat or grouse

clue.text: Wrestler, perhaps, clever to hang on to the ear

clue.text: Inclination to write song

parts.note: to pen is to write
a chant is a song

explanation.surface: A fondness for writing songs.

clue.text: Distinguished opener in tests practised

clue.text: Start, in slightly poor shape, on first of aerobic classes

parts.note: to have a bad time is to experience it

clue.text: Jam spread thinly on bread

definitions.text: one playing it takes a bow

clue.text: Smash hit, a crass release

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written
